data.Title: New Year Special
data.Announcement: Start 2026 strong! Get 20% off all Standard 2-Phase accounts this month. Use code NEWYEAR20 at checkout.

data.Title: Valentine's Bundle
data.Announcement: Double the love! Purchase any account with the Double Up add-on and receive an extra 5% reward share for the first cycle.

data.Title: Platform Update v3.2
data.Announcement: We've updated the dashboard with improved charting and faster order execution. All existing accounts are automatically upgraded.

data.Title: Weekend Trading Policy Reminder
data.Announcement: Reminder: Weekend holding is allowed during the evaluation phase but not on funded accounts. Please close all positions before the weekend on your live accounts.

data.Title: Holiday Season Promo
data.Announcement: Happy holidays! Enjoy 25% off all account sizes. Plus, the Passing Reward is doubled (200%) for all purchases this month.

data.Title: Reward Split Update
data.Announcement: Starting November 15, all new funded accounts will have an 80% base reward split (previously 75%). Existing accounts are grandfathered at their current rates.

data.Title: Black Friday Deal
data.Announcement: Our biggest sale of the year! 30% off ALL account types + 300% Passing Reward campaign. Limited time only.

data.Title: Launch Promo Campaign
data.Announcement: Introducing our launch_promo campaign! Get a Standard account at a special promotional price. Limited to 10,000 accounts.

data.Title: New: Direct Start Accounts
data.Announcement: We're excited to introduce Direct Start accounts -- skip the evaluation and start trading with real funded capital immediately. Features a 6% trailing loss limit and tier-based growth.

data.Title: Payout Processing Improvement
data.Announcement: Good news! All reward payouts are now processed within 24 hours of request. We've added PayProvider and USDC as new payout methods alongside existing options.
